title: Award (staff)
body:
Syntax: award <player> <amount>

Description: Adds `amount` mission points to a player's current balance -- unlike 'mset <player> mission_points <n>', which can only overwrite the balance outright to an exact value, this adjusts it relative to whatever it already is. A negative amount deducts instead; the balance never goes below 0.

Matches exactly how a real mission completion grants points: both the spendable balance and the player's lifetime mission-points-earned total (used for leaderboards) move together on a grant -- except the lifetime total only ever increases, even on a deduction, since it's meant to record real history, not track a net balance.

&D(Staff only -- requires administrator access.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
